gogaenseliesel.name: Gänseliesel
gogaenseliesel.slogan: A bronze goose girl, kissed by every new doctor in town.
gogaenseliesel.line: The town of Göttingen, famous for its sausages and university, belongs to the King of Hanover.

gomuendenrathaus.name: Hann. Münden Town Hall
gomuendenrathaus.slogan: Weser Renaissance gables above 700 timbered houses.
gomuendenrathaus.line: Its Gothic hall dates from the 14th century; the Renaissance façade was added between 1603 and 1618.

goweserstein.name: Weserstein
goweserstein.slogan: Two rivers meet on a small island and stop being themselves.
goweserstein.line: Where Werra and Fulda kiss, they must atone with their names.
goweserstein.by: Inscription on the Weserstein, Hann. Münden, 1899

gomuenchhausenmuseum.name: Münchhausen Museum
gomuenchhausenmuseum.slogan: The manor where the famous liar was born, and told his tall tales.
gomuenchhausenmuseum.line: Baron Münchhausen (1720-1797) is buried in Bodenwerder, and the town bought his house in 1935 for its town hall.

goaltesrathaus.name: Altes Rathaus
goaltesrathaus.slogan: Painted hall behind the Gänseliesel, heart of the old market.
goaltesrathaus.line: Göttingen's Old Town Hall took from 1366 to 1444 to build.
